subject.title: feat: add account feed model API

question: Should this PR publish account and publisher feed routes now, and must that first slice preserve the current legacy personal-publisher fallback boundary before merge?
rationale: This creates a new public feed contract and the remaining compatibility boundary is a product/API decision rather than a purely mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Require compatibility before public API
options.body: Land only after account feed resolution reuses existing personal-publisher fallbacks, legacy ownerUserId feed entries are covered, and live route proof is posted.

options.title: Accept ownerPublisherId-only first slice
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally ship the narrower contract, accepting that legacy personal-publisher content can be absent from the new feed.

options.title: Pause for discovery contract review
options.body: Wait to settle the account feed and registry bridge shapes together before publishing new stable routes.

recommendation.title: Require compatibility before public API
recommendation.body: Land only after account feed resolution reuses existing personal-publisher fallbacks, legacy ownerUserId feed entries are covered, and live route proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied by blame and commit metadata to the publisher fallback, schema, dashboard compatibility, and adjacent hosted feed behavior.
